direction_class_weights_note: inverse frequency on train, N/(3*count_k), index order neutral, positive, negative
strength_note: sigmoid head, MSE only on non-neutral types; slot value = sign x strength
input_format: tokenizer(context, text) as a sentence pair when context is non-empty, else tokenizer(text); max_length 128
row_weight: multiply each row's total loss by its `weight` field (0.5 for bare O*NET phrases, train only)
job_zone_filter: float(job_zone) >= 4 and z-scores present -> 378 recommendable occupations
